# komodo_server (Data Source)

Fetches a Komodo server by ID or name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Server ID or name.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String)
- `auto_prune` (Boolean)

- `cpu_warning` (Number)
- `disk_critical` (Number)

- `links` (List of String)
